tasks.title: Conversation #13
tasks.transcript:
Man: Mary Soul, is impossible to increase the budget for the sales department.
Woman: Maybe. What's it for?
Man: I'd like to promote one of our assistants, David, to sales representative.
He's really distinguished himself since he joined our company last year with his excellent customer service skills, he's a real asset to the department.
Woman: Okay. That sounds reasonable. I’ll run some numbers and I'll let you know promptly.

questions.stem: What does the man ask the woman about?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士向女士询问了什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士在对话开头提出的核心问题。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士在对话开头明确问“is it possible to increase the budget for the sales department?”，即他询问的是关于预算的问题。 选项B：错误。 对话中完全没有提到执照或许可证，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项C：错误。 对话中未提及任何调查结果，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 女士在最后说“I'll run some numbers”，但这是她为了回应预算问题而要做的事情，并非男士询问的内容。男士询问的是预算，而非销售数据本身。

questions.stem: What will most likely happen to David?

options.A: He will attend a sales conference.
options.B: He will receive a job promotion.
options.C: He will be sent on a business trip.
options.D: He will be transferred to a new department.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问David很可能会发生什么事，属于推理判断题，需根据男士对David的评价及其提出的请求进行推断。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中完全没有提到销售会议，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“I'd like to promote one of our assistants, David, to sales representative”，即他希望将David晋升为销售代表。女士回应“That sounds reasonable”，说明晋升很可能发生。 选项C：错误。 对话中未提及出差，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：错误。 男士希望将David从助理晋升为销售代表，这属于同一部门内的晋升，而非调到新部门。
